submission.justification: At 30% coverage (the maximum allowed; light collection rises monotonically with coverage, ~coverage^0.8), Geant4 simulation gives D2 51.4 PE/MeV, D1 37.8, D3 24.7 (100k events each), consistent with the 2025 summary at 20% (38/27/18). Feedthroughs support 30% (meeting notes 2026-01-20) and cold electronics are validated for all designs. CAVEAT: no project document provides any robustness/reliability evidence for any design. D2's thin bonded dichroic filter is a plausible failure mode under cryogenic thermal cycling (delamination/cracking), which matters because modules are inaccessible after fill. This recommendation is conditional on D2 passing cryogenic thermal-cycling and long-term LAr immersion qualification before the Q3 design freeze; if it fails, fall back to Module-D1 (WLS bar + SiPM, simpler construction) at 30% coverage (~37.8 PE/MeV).
